source.author: lucr
source.text: nec pietas ullast velatum saepe videri vertier ad lapidem atque omnis accedere ad aras nec procumbere humi prostratum et pandere palmas ante deum delubra nec aras sanguine multo spargere quadrupedum nec votis nectere vota, sed mage pacata posse omnia mente tueri.
source.text_original: nec pietas ullast velatum saepe videri / vertier ad lapidem atque omnis accedere ad aras / nec procumbere humi prostratum et pandere palmas / ante deum delubra nec aras sanguine multo / spargere quadrupedum nec votis nectere vota, / sed mage pacata posse omnia mente tueri.
source.text_english: There is no piety in being often seen with one’s head veiled, turning toward a stone and approaching all the altars, nor in prostrating oneself on the ground and spreading out one’s palms before the shrines of the gods, nor in sprinkling the altars with much blood of four-footed beasts, nor in linking vow to vow, but rather in being able to view all things with a mind at peace.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: denique alio loco religiones et cultus deorum inane esse officium confitetur: nec pietas ulla est uelatum saepe uideri uertere se ad lapidem atque omnis ad aras et procumbere humi prostratum et pandere palmas ante deum delubra nec aras sanguine multo spargere quadrupedum nec uotis nectere uota.
reuse.text_original: denique alio loco religiones et cultus deorum inane esse officium confitetur: nec pietas ulla est uelatum saepe uideri uertere se ad lapidem atque omnis ad aras et procumbere humi prostratum et pandere palmas ante deum delubra nec aras sanguine multo spargere quadrupedum nec uotis nectere uota.
reuse.text_english: Finally, in another passage he admits that religions and the worship of the gods are an empty duty: nor is there any piety in being often seen with veiled head, turning to a stone and to fall down prostrate before all the altars, and to spread out one’s palms before the shrines of the gods, nor in sprinkling the altars with much blood of four-footed animals, nor in adding vows to vows with vows.
